mapper.sql: mn.id as id, mn.Acp_id as acpid, mn.Ima_Code as imaCode, mn.Ima_BidBondMoney as imaBidBondMoney, mn.Ima_Payee as imaPayee, mn.Ima_Payee_Bank as imaPayeeBank, mn.Ima_Payee_CA_Name as imaPayeeCaName, mn.Ima_Payee_CA as imaPayeeCa, mn.Ima_Remark as imaRemark, mn.Create_Uid as createUid, mn.Create_Uname as createUname, mn.Create_Time as createTime, mn.Update_Uid as updateUid, mn.Update_Uname as updateUname, mn.Update_Time as updateTime, mn.State as state, mn.State_Time as stateTime

choose.otherwise: and (c1.C_Name like concat('%',#{params.imaPayeeName},'%') or c1.C_Abbreviation like concat('%',#{params.imaPayeeName},'%') )

mapper.select:
select pia.Pia_Code as piaCode, pia.Pia_Name as piaName, pia.Pia_Area as piaArea, pia.Pia_Type as piaType, pia.Pia_Developer as piaDeveloper, c1.C_Name as imaPayeeName, c1.C_Abbreviation as imaPayeeAbbName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId,
from Acpm_InvituoMarginApplication mn left join Acpm_ProjectInvestmentApproval pia on pia.id=mn.Acp_id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Ima_Payee left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.id where mn.id=#{id}
select count(1) from Acpm_InvituoMarginApplication mn left join Acpm_ProjectInvestmentApproval pia on pia.id=mn.Acp_id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Ima_Payee
